parameters.help_en:
The OSS address of the media file to be moderated. Video files and audio files are supported. You can obtain the address from ApsaraVideo Media Processing console > Media Management > Media Library. To moderate image files, use the `CoverImage` parameter. This is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

Bucket: The name of the OSS bucket for the input file.
Location: The OSS region, which must be the same as the region of the ApsaraVideo Media Processing service.
Object: The OSS object to be moderated.

    > The Object value cannot start with a forward slash (/). Otherwise, the API call fails

Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。
Location：OSS区域，必须和MPS服务所在区域一致。
Object：待检测OSS Object。

    > Object不能以斜杠（/）开头，否则会导致接口调用失败

parameters.help_en:
The MPS queue ID, which is used to bindmessage notifications. You can obtain the ID from ApsaraVideo Media Processing console > Global Settings > MPS Queue. If you leave this parameter empty, the default MPS queue is used to run the task. The default MPS queue supports a concurrency of 10. To increase the concurrency, <props="china">submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/mts/recommend/1186)</props><props="intl">submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.12246746.top-nav.ditem-sub.35da7bbcitpQnr#/ticket/createIndex)</props>.
MPS queues can be created only in the backend. For related query and update operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188374.html

parameters.help_en:
The video moderation configuration and the OSS address for output snapshots. You can obtain the address from ApsaraVideo Media Processing console > Media Management > Media Library.

JSON object.

OutputFile:
    - Bucket: The name of the OSS bucket for the output file.
    - Location: The OSS region, which must be the same as the region of the ApsaraVideo Media Processing service.
    - Object: The OSS object to be moderated. {Count} is the placeholder for the sequence number of captured frames.

   The detailed moderation results are saved in the same folder as OutputFile, named {jobId}.output. For the specific field format of the output file, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609186.html.
StoreVideoTimeline: Specifies whether to output a `{jobId}.video_timeline` file and store it in OSS. Set the value to true to output the file or false to skip the output. If you leave this parameter empty, the file is not output by default. For the file format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91779.html.
SaveType: The output mode. Set the value to abnormal to output only problematic frames, or all to output all frames.
Biztype: The moderation template. The default template is common. If you leave this parameter empty, common is used by default. To customize a moderation template, submit a ticket and then enter the user UID in this field.
Scene: The detection scenario. You can select detection scenarios. If you leave this parameter empty, terrorism and pornography detection are used by default. Available scenarios:

    - porn: Pornography detection
    - terrorism: Terrorism detection
    - ad: Image and text violation detection
    - live: Undesirable scene detection
    - logo: Logo detection

    - audio: Audio anti-spam detection

For input files with audio tracks, the audio scenario performs audio moderation. Do not specify audio for input files without audio tracks
parameters.help_zh:
视频审核配置和输出截图的OSS地址。可以通过MPS控制台 > 媒体管理 > 媒体列表获取。

JSON对象。

OutputFile：
    - Bucket：输出文件OSS Bucket名字。
    - Location：OSS区域，必须和MPS服务所在区域一致。
    - Object: 待检测OSS Object，其中{Count}为截帧图片序号替换符。

   其中，审核结果详细信息保存在OutputFile相同的文件夹下，命名为{jobId}.output，output文件具体字段格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609186.html。
StoreVideoTimeline: 审核是否要输出`{jobId}.video_timeline`文件，存储在OSS中。true：表示要输出，false表示不输出，不填默认不输出。文件格式，请参见，https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91779.html。
SaveType：输出模式。abnormal表示只输出有问题的截帧，all表示输出所有截帧。
Biztype：表示审核模版。common为默认模版，不填默认为common，如果需要自定义审核模版需要提工单，然后将用户的uid填入此项。
Scene：检测场景。Scenes可以选择检测场景，不填默认检测暴恐和涉黄。可选场景：

    - porn：涉黄
    - terrorism：暴恐
    - ad：图文违规
    - live：不良场景
    - logo：图标

    - audio：语音反垃圾

对于有音频轨道的输入文件，audio场景会进行音频审核，没有音轨的输入文件不要填写audio
